name: Business Banking App — Design System
organization: A major Israeli bank (client, via Zemingo)
context: A client engagement at Zemingo for one of Israel's major banks (name withheld — confidential client work): the design system for the bank's business-banking app. The client is never named publicly; the agent says 'a major Israeli bank'.
summary: The design system for a major Israeli bank's business-banking app, built by Boaz's design team at Zemingo and now delivered and in the development team's hands. An atomic library — colors and type through text fields, tables, filters, date pickers, cards, modals and system pages — with dedicated accessibility tracks, and a Transitions layer that specifies micro-interaction behavior. On top of it, an AI workflow: the interaction specs become running, near-production prototypes, so developers receive behavior they can run, inspect and lift from — not static annotations they have to interpret.

artifacts.label: חתימות — פעולות בסוויפ
artifacts.description: The signatures queue with the swipe spec implemented: a partial drag reveals sign/reject, continuing the drag makes the sign action take over the surface, and a full swipe commits — badge count and card state update live. Placeholder data only.

artifacts.label: סינון — שדות, צ׳יפים ותגיות
artifacts.description: The filter sheet's specified behaviors, running: date presets rewrite the from/to fields, custom typing releases the preset, the CTA arms only when something changed, reset returns everything, and applied filters collapse to tags where deleting one reveals the next.

artifacts.label: בחירת חשבון — חיפוש ובחירה
artifacts.description: The account-picker bottom sheet: slide-up over the dimmed page, live search over name and number, radio selection, and favorite pinning. Placeholder accounts only.

conversation_hooks.agent_response_goal: Use as the flagship design-system evidence: a full atomic library for a major Israeli bank's business app — atoms through organisms, accessibility tracks, and a Transitions layer that specifies behavior, not just looks. Never name the bank. Show the running prototypes as proof the system is executable, not a sticker sheet.

Tell the workflow story: the system's Transitions page documents interaction specs as annotated frames; with AI those become interactive, near-production prototypes — real RTL Hebrew markup on the system's tokens — that developers run, inspect and lift from, alongside the specs. Show the prototypes and invite the visitor to actually use them. Never name the bank.

presentation.long_pitch: A design system for a major Israeli bank's business-banking app, built by the Zemingo design team Boaz leads and now delivered: an atomic library from tokens to system pages, dedicated accessibility tracks, and a Transitions layer specifying micro-interaction behavior. The AI workflow on top turns those specs into interactive prototypes in near-production code — developers receive behavior they can run and lift from, together with the specs, instead of interpreting static frames.
